data.description: 【希斯特里亚 · 兵团野外】兵团行军的间歇，希斯特里亚在草原上扎起低马尾，棕色制服与绿披风被风吹动，她回头露出那个标志性的温柔笑容——「休息时间，要一起吃点干粮吗？」
data.promptProse: Historia pauses during the march and smiles back across the grassland. Wind lifts the loose strands of her low ponytail, while the sunlit grass leads toward the distant horizon.
data.title: 希斯特里亚 · 兵团野外
data.animaCaption: She pauses during the march and smiles toward the viewer across the grassland.
